children: Shares of medical technology company Glaukos were trading at new highs after hours after the company issued higher net sales guidance for the year.
After the bell, the company's stock had risen almost 18%, to $213.90. The stock touched an all-time high of $191.61 on Aug. 20.

Glaukos reported third-quarter earnings per share of 3 cents on record third-quarter sales of $211 million. In the year-ago period, the company had a loss per share of 28 cents on sales of $133.5 million.

Glaukos raised its 2026 net sales guidance to a range of $775 million to $785 million, from a prior range of $680 million to $700 million. The company also introduced preliminary 2027 net sales guidance of $1 billion.
Glaukos said it is an ophthalmic pharmaceutical and medical technology company focused on novel therapies for the treatment of glaucoma, corneal disorders, and retinal diseases.
